# Configurator Test Instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md), [PROJECTS.md](../../PROJECTS.md) and the [test rule](../../.agents/rules/tests.md). Use deterministic TUnit/MTP tests, public behavioral seams and exact scoped evidence. No Event database matrix, source scraping, sleeps, warning suppressions or weakened tests.
